predecessors.name: Kingdom of Denmark (1814-1940)
predecessors.text: Iceland, which 'On 1 December 1918, the Act of Union, an agreement with Denmark, recognized ... as a fully sovereign state'

successors.name: Republic of Iceland
successors.text: the whole island: 'Iceland formally became a republic on 17 June 1944'

ledger.x: 1918, 1 December: Iceland becomes a sovereign kingdom.
1941, 7 July: the United States takes over Iceland's defence from Britain: the defence was 'transferred from Britain' on 7 July 1941 after the US agreement of 16 June.
1941, 7-8 July: American forces replace the British.
1944, 17 June: bookkeeping end of this dossier's occupation pair.

wars.name: Operation Fork (British occupation of Iceland)
wars.outcome: The Royal Navy and Royal Marines landed at Reykjavik on 10 May 1940 without a fight beyond a protest; commonwealth forces 'eventually totalled 25,000'; the United States took over the defence on 7 July 1941.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border; Cliopatria draws the same 458 cells throughout.
